The Mayor and City Councilmembers are elected city officials as identified in Government Code § 87200 and are required to file Statements of Economic Interests (Form 700) with the City Clerk’s office. Copies of the Form 700 filings submitted by the elected officials listed below may be obtained by visiting either of the following locations:

- Fair Political Practices Commission (FPPC)

1102 Q Street, Suite 3000

Sacramento, California 95811

- El Cajon City Clerk’s Office

200 Civic Center Way

El Cajon, California 92020

 

**City of El Cajon Elected Officials:**

- Mayor Bill Wells
- Mayor Pro Tem Gary Kendrick
- Councilmember Steve Goble
- Councilmember Michelle Metschel
- Councilmember Phil Ortiz

### [*Search for Form 700 filings submitted to the City of El Cajon here*](https://public.netfile.com/pub/?AID=CJN).

Form 700 filings for certain state and local government elected officials are available and searchable in electronic format on the [FPPC's website](https://www.fppc.ca.gov).

Please see the links below for additional information and resources related to Statements of Economic Interests:

- [FPPC: Statements of Economic Interests - Form 700](https://www.fppc.ca.gov/Form700.html)
- [Legislative Information: Ca. Gov. Code § 87200](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=87200.&lawCode=GOV)
